f-2: City of Promise is Charlottesville's hub for dual-generation early intervention, focused on literacy and chronic absenteeism. We equip children and families with the support, coaching, and whole-family tools and resources they deserve, because education is a social issue that no school can solve alone, and every kid deserves to learn to read.
